svg.aria-label: ESM-2 masked-marginal scores against Kir2.1 surface expression and channel function
svg.text: ESM-2 masked marginals against two Kir2.1 assays, on identical variants
Zero-shot prediction (x) versus measured outcome (y). ProteinGym v1.3, KCNJ2_MOUSE, Coyote-Maestas 2022.
A computational replication on public data. A prediction remains a prediction.
Positions scored: 391 distinct of 391 in the matched set (residues 1–428)
n = 6789 matched variants (every matched variant); checkpoint facebook/esm2_t33_650M_UR50D; masked marginals, zero-shot.
Δρ (surface − function) = -0.035, 95% CI [-0.062, -0.009] by variant; [-0.090, +0.018] clustered by position; paired
H1 (better agreement with surface expression): UNDETERMINED, from the position clustered interval (the wider one). The
variant-level interval excludes zero and the position-clustered one does not. Variants at a position share a residue, an
environment and one forward pass, so the clustered interval governs and the difference is not resolved here. An interval
Assay-to-assay ρ = +0.290: the model tracks each assay about as closely as the two assays track each other. Function is
measured downstream of surface expression, so they are not independent readouts — though this ρ is lower than that alone
ESM-2 masked-marginal score (log p(mut) − log p(wt), higher = more tolerated)
